_comment: The campaign's module order and waves (crustify specs/artifacts/schedule.md, schema 6), planner run 10.

Waves 0-202 with status done are the wrap campaign's, kept as they ran. Waves 203-686 are the libavutil port, from one seeded body-deep wavefront schedule (--with-enums), and its later stages (port/layout, port/memory, port/unexport) after the waves of the modules whose integration frees them.

Release points are wavefront's: module names are written <link-unit>/<name>, a user's `wave` is wavefront's own numbering of that schedule, and `module: null` names C no module of the plan owns (the libraries the pilot leaves out, fftools), which stays C.

libavutil/pixelutils.c is configured out: the ingest profile builds it with CONFIG_PIXELUTILS 0, a stub that stays C, so it has no port waves and the release points that named it as a user name it as C no module owns. Its wrap wave 53 is kept as it ran.
